stories.title: River Dee only Welsh river where nitrate has risen in 25 years, analysis finds
stories.summary: The River Dee is the only river in Wales where nitrate levels have risen over the past 25 years, according to an analysis of Natural Resources Wales records by the charity Afonydd Cymru. stories.title: Senedd rejects calls to ban phones in classrooms
stories.summary: The Senedd has rejected a Reform UK call for a legal ban on mobile phones in classrooms across Wales. Members voted 50 to 38 against the motion on Wednesday, 4 November, after a debate in the Siambr. stories.title: North Wales Police online reporting and webchat to be disrupted on Friday morning
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s online reporting and webchat services are likely to be affected for several hours on Friday morning because of planned maintenance work. stories.title: Flintshire council officer says debate over councillor pay has become “toxic”
stories.summary: A senior Flintshire Council officer has said the debate over councillors’ pay has become “toxic”. Gareth Owens, the council’s chief officer for governance, told a committee on Thursday, 5 November: “It’s a real shame that the debate about this is so toxic because, of course, public services are a really important aspect of our community.”
